name: Young! Fire!
source:
Ready to bench press 355 kilos? Not for media or magazines, but for the most important thing in a person's life — respect from your friends! Or pedal a catamaran through a raging storm just to reach your beloved? Forget ordinary rules — here you need titanic strength, a passionate sincere heart, and friends who have your back like a mountain!

Young! Fire! — this is an explosion of teenage passion, where every date becomes an epic battle, and every word is a strike of fate. Four legendary friends dive into the whirlpool of love, which throws them into different worlds: shonen epic, retro-futuristic detective, criminal thriller, and many more!

We invite you to live the story of Youth of these unbreakable love-struck power monsters

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4276150/Young_Fire/]Steam[/url]]
